Choose the language of the app. The screen reloads after you change it.
Manage a separate key for each provider. Keys are encrypted on this device and sent only to the selected provider. Checking a key does not confirm model access or quota.
Input is cleared when submitted. Save checks the current key again and saves only a verified key. Re-enter the key to retry.
Delete the %1$s key from this device? Future requests will require a new key. This does not revoke the key with the provider.
Key deleted. Provider is no longer configured.
Secure storage is unavailable. No saved key is displayed. Retry when the device is ready.
Stored key cannot be decrypted. It has not been replaced. Delete it explicitly, then enter a new key.
Enter a non-empty key without spaces or line breaks.
The operation could not be completed. Retry.
VALID — authentication accepted. Model access and quota can still be restricted. Nothing was saved by this check.
INVALID — the provider rejected authentication. The saved key has not changed.
UNVERIFIED — access is restricted (403). This does not prove the key is invalid. Nothing was saved.
UNVERIFIED — rate limit reached. Retry later. Nothing was saved.
UNVERIFIED — provider temporarily unavailable. Retry later. Nothing was saved.
UNVERIFIED — network unavailable. Check your connection. Nothing was saved.
UNVERIFIED — request timed out. Retry. Nothing was saved.
UNVERIFIED — authentication could not be confirmed. Nothing was saved.
Add, check, replace or delete your own OpenAI and Gemini keys. Keys are encrypted and stored only on this device.
Choose the provider and model for each kind of work. Only providers with a saved API key can be selected, and the app never switches provider on its own.
Could not load model settings. Reopen this screen to retry.
Sorts comments into question, praise, feedback, negative and spam.
Illustrations for posts. Image models can cost more and need access on your account.
Pick a suggestion or type a model ID. Access depends on your account.
Needs an API key: add a %1$s key or choose another provider. Nothing is sent until then.
No model selected. The app will use offline image templates.
The saved model is not valid for this task. Choose another model.
Saved, but this model name does not look like a model for this kind of work. Check that it works with your account.
This provider has no API key yet. Add one in API keys first.
Model ID is too long (at most 128 characters).
Model ID may contain only letters, digits and . _ : / -
This model cannot be used for this kind of work.
This provider is not supported yet.
The operation could not be completed. Retry.

Review and approve AI-generated drafts before publishing. The agent never publishes automatically.
Create a topic first. Generated drafts will appear here for your approval before publishing.
Approval required before this draft can be published.
Confirm that you have reviewed the content and allow it to be published when you choose.
Draft approved. You can publish it now.

Cannot approve an empty or missing draft.

This draft has not been approved yet and cannot be published.

Added to the publishing queue. It will be posted automatically when you are online.
This draft is already waiting in the publishing queue.

Start typing to preview your post…

You have unsaved edits. Leaving now will discard them.
View saved versions of this draft and restore an earlier version anytime.
Versions are recorded automatically whenever the agent generates or you save edits to this draft.
This replaces the current draft content and revokes approval so you can review before publishing.
Version restored. Re-approval is required before publishing.
Version restored and approval revoked, but the new history entry could not be saved.
Could not restore this version. Please try again.
Something went wrong while loading this draft history. Please reopen and try again.
Could not load draft version history. Please try again.
